description: Capture a complete immutable Part 1 custody packet without terminating a host or removing a worktree. Required agent_instance_id, unit_id, repository_id and assignment_sha256 must match the verified stored managed-session assignment. The target root and lane name come exclusively from that row, never a caller path or ambient root. Calls require the exact current binding of the spawning coordinator role, reusing the managed-dispatch coordinator succession authorizer; no role or call-context privilege is granted. First call read_lane_evidence without packet_id to obtain its snapshot-only fingerprint and bounded inventory, then pass that fingerprint as required expected_fingerprint here. Required disposition is preserved or superseded; required rationale explains custody. Superseded always means superseded with verified evidence, never discarded. Optional predecessor_packet_id must verify under the same binding. Correction creates a new capture with predecessor and rationale; set/correct/clear predecessor means a new immutable capture with selected or omitted predecessor. Original and successor remain accessible by explicit packet_id. Omission clears only that request; no mutable latest selector exists. Stale fingerprints, identity/path violations, unsupported index or protected payload return named integrity failures and keep the source. Missing non-integrity actor/audit text is advisory. Every published packet is retained indefinitely: no prune, expire, delete or reopen. For retirement, this immutable packet may be selected only by a separately authorized retire_session request that supplies packet_id and the same expected_fingerprint; retirement re-verifies the whole packet and a fresh complete bound lane inventory before host action and again before removal. A single retire_session request may instead specify preserve_evidence=true with expected_fingerprint, disposition, rationale and optional predecessor_packet_id; that request captures and verifies the packet before proceeding. These request fields describe the retirement workflow and grant no host or removal authority to this process. A manually copied directory or its hashes are not native packet custody. While the original managed lane exists, capture that original through native preserve and keep any external Controller copy intact. This does not import an external root or recover bytes after the original is absent. Packet recovery proves bytes only, not landing, host death or deletion authority. Registered calls return a persisted {job_id, status: queued} admission before the complete operation runs on the messaging owner worker. Read job_service.get_job by that exact job_id until terminal; job.result contains the complete original response envelope, and failures also retain job.error. The receipt reports admission; the operation outcome, full history and readback are in that exact job. Direct Python and direct HTTP callers retain their synchronous operation and response. Do not replay effects after an uncertain terminal write or a lost receipt; reconcile the owned job and actual outcome.
embedding_description: Capture exact evidence for a bound managed lane in an immutable native packet. The packet can support a separately authorized retire_session request after fresh fingerprint verification; preservation itself never terminates a host or removes a worktree. Manual copies and hashes are not native custody. Capture the still-extant original lane and retain any external copy.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: code, custody_verified, complete, packet_id, fingerprint, binding, provenance (actor, disposition, rationale, predecessor), bounded summary, incomplete_count and advisories. Native append-only Unit audit records creation/successor/disposition using the actual caller. custody_audit_unavailable is advisory and valid local custody still succeeds. Native audit correction/withdrawal affects observations only; it never changes or supplies byte-custody proof. No result authorizes deletion.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Distinguish snapshot-only inventory from verified immutable custody. Show named integrity failures and advisories, preserve immutable packet ids, and never claim termination, removal, landing or deletion authority. Treat a queued job id as admission only. Retrieve the terminal job before presenting the original operation outcome.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Authorization and identity/path-integrity violations refuse. Ancillary audit unavailability is an advisory on successful local custody. Unsupported index/protected leaf state remains in place and cannot yield a complete packet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use the stored managed identity and current coordinator binding. Read a fresh bound snapshot before capture and pass its complete fingerprint as expected_fingerprint. For retirement, use retire_session with either an existing packet_id plus expected_fingerprint, or preserve_evidence=true plus expected_fingerprint, disposition and rationale; the retirement verb re-verifies custody before host action and removal. If the original lane still exists, capture that lane through native preserve and keep external copies untouched. A manual directory or hash is not a native custody packet. Preserve protected or unsupported state in place; never delete it to make custody pass.
